# Overview

This reproducible Quarto book regenerates Figures 1-6 for:

> **Resuscitation Drives the Emergence of Dominant Taxa in the Maize Seed Microbiota**

The source documents start from processed input tables and rerun the
figure-level analyses, including alpha and beta diversity, differential
abundance, co-occurrence networks, GWAS Manhattan plots, genome comparisons,
BIOLOG, metabolomics, and RNA-seq enrichment.

Chenliao Wu, Cong Lan, Amina Hadayat, En Luo, Jun-Hao Huang, Xuan Ming,

## Reproduction boundary

The bundled data are sufficient to render Figures 1-6 without downloading raw
sequencing reads. Upstream steps such as DADA2, BLINK GWAS, metagenomic
assembly and binning, ANI, nucmer, and SNP calling are documented in
`PROVENANCE.md` but are outside the execution scope of this repository.

## Build

```bash
Rscript -e 'renv::restore()'
make check
make render
```

Render outputs are written to `_book/`, `output/figures/`, and
`figures/release/`.
